ok.label: Active
ok.hint: This license is valid and can be used on activated devices.

notActivated.label: Not activated
notActivated.hint: This server hasn't activated a license for this product yet, so it can't hand out seats.

expired.label: Expired
expired.hint: This license has passed its expiry date and no longer works until it is renewed.

suspended.label: Suspended
suspended.hint: This license is temporarily paused. It starts working again on its own once the software vendor lifts the suspension.

gracePeriodOver.label: Grace period over
gracePeriodOver.hint: This server couldn't sync with Cryptlex in time, so it stopped handing out seats until it syncs again.

disabled.label: Disabled
disabled.hint: This product is turned off in config.yml, so this server does not serve it.

allowedFloatingClients.label: Concurrent Seats
allowedFloatingClients.hint: Devices holding a seat right now, out of the maximum allowed at the same time. A device frees its seat when the app closes or its lease runs out.

totalOfflineFloatingClients.label: Offline Devices
totalOfflineFloatingClients.hint: Devices holding a seat through an offline lease, so they don't need to reach this server until the lease ends.

expiresAt.label: Expires
expiresAt.hint: The license stops working after this date. Renewing the subscription moves the date forward.

serverSyncGracePeriodExpiresAt.label: Sync Grace Period Ends
serverSyncGracePeriodExpiresAt.hint: If this server can't reach Cryptlex to sync the license, it keeps handing out seats until this time.

leasingStrategy.label: Leasing Strategy
leasingStrategy.hint: How seats are counted: per machine gives each device one seat, per instance gives each running copy of the app its own seat.

online.hint: Activated over the internet. Changes to the license reach this server automatically when it syncs.

offline.hint: Activated without internet using a response file. This server doesn't sync, so changes to the license don't reach it until it's activated again.

featureEntitlements.label: Features
featureEntitlements.hint: Features this license unlocks, with the value or expiry date that applies to each, if any.

leaseDuration.label: Lease Duration
leaseDuration.hint: How long a device can hold a seat without checking in. Products use this unless they override it. If the app closes without releasing its seat, for example after a crash, the seat becomes free when the lease runs out.

allowedClockOffset.label: Allowed Clock Offset
allowedClockOffset.hint: How far a device's clock can differ from this server's before its requests are refused.

blockedIps.label: Blocked IPs
blockedIps.hint: IP addresses refused by this server.

trustedProxies.label: Trusted Proxies
trustedProxies.hint: Proxies whose forwarded client IP this server accepts.
